why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate is up +0.55% so far, which sits right at the 0.5% bar, but the data has no segment cuts, so the mechanism is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: On day 14, with about 900000 users per arm, a Successful Search Rate range that sits wholly above 0.5% and guardrails within their margins would make this a win.
A Successful Search Rate range that sits wholly below 0.5% at the planned sample would mean the bar is ruled out.
A pre-exposure comparison and a daily series by days since first exposure, neither in this export, would let the pre-period and novelty checks run.
